mandatory: The reading order is top to bottom: start node, then the 'First, ask' box, then the two branch boxes side by side at the bottom
Both branch boxes are soft amber and identical in size and style; neither is highlighted, larger or marked as preferred
'promo-agent-shadow' is in a monospace face on ONE line inside a wide red pill
Each branch text line is on one line in semibold near-black (#1F2328), not grey
Exactly one arrow runs from the start node down into the 'First, ask' box, and exactly two amber arrows leave the 'First, ask' box, one to each branch box; nothing leaves the branch boxes
'Today: at least the whole customer table' is on ONE line inside a wide red pill, set in sans-serif, not monospace; only 'promo-agent-shadow' is monospace
The title is bold, large, top-left and on one line
All text is large enough to read when the image is 1000px wide
'What does its job need?' and 'What can it reach if misused?' are semibold near-black (#1F2328), as dark as the heading; they are the point of the figure and are never grey, faint or light
prohibitions: NO green anywhere in the image
NO check marks, ticks, crosses, stars, 'recommended' badges or any mark that favours one branch
NO verdict, result or outcome box below the branches
NO third-party logos and NO Google logo
NO 'Vertex AI', 'Agent Engine', 'reasoning engine' or 'reasoningEngines' anywhere
NO project IDs, NO email addresses, NO '@' characters
NO people, faces, hands or characters
NO text that is not listed in text_exact
NO identifier broken across two lines (never 'promo-agent-' on one line and 'shadow' on the next)
NO grey or faint text anywhere; every label is near-black (#1F2328)
NO thick, block or 3D arrows; every arrow is a thin 2px line
alt_text: The title reads: Own it or kill it. At the top, promo-agent-shadow in red, which reads customer records. An arrow leads down to a box, First, ask, with two questions: What does its job need? and What can it reach if misused? The second question carries a red answer: Today: at least the whole customer table. From that box, two amber arrows lead to two equal amber boxes: Kill it (Fast, hides the problem, breaks a team) and Own it (Named owner, access cut to the job).
